idea-plugin.name: Claude Sessions Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Companion plugin for Claude Sessions, a desktop widget that shows the state of every Claude Code session you have running.

Inside the IDE it does three things:

  • Names terminal tabs after their session, so a row of Local, Local (2), Local (3) tabs becomes readable at a glance. A tab you renamed yourself is never touched.
  • Jumps to the session that needs you. Clicking a row in the widget raises the IDE and focuses the terminal tab running that session; right-click closes the tab and ends the session.
  • Adds Tools | New Claude Session, which opens a terminal tab and starts a session in the current project's directory.

The launch command is configurable under Settings | Tools | Claude Sessions and defaults to claude. It runs in an interactive shell, so your own shell alias works there too.

Tab naming and click-to-jump need the desktop app installed with its Claude Code hooks enabled — the plugin reads the state the app writes under ~/.claude/session-status/. Without the app, New Claude Session still works and the rest stays idle.

Not affiliated with Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic PBC.
